summary: Read two integer arrays called A and B. Each array contains between 1 and 1000 values, and every value is an integer that is at least 0 and strictly less than 100. Find one contiguous block inside A and one contiguous block inside B that hold exactly the same numbers in the same order. Write the greatest length any such matching pair of blocks can reach.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
